comment: The window is built in src/Brink/dsp.h:137 as centre minus half the span to centre plus half the span, so WIDTH is the total span and not a distance from the midpoint. HYSTERESIS at src/Brink/dsp.h:12 is 0.001, applied to every boundary test in advance_region. The four boundary triggers last 0.001 seconds, set in start_pulse at src/Brink/dsp.h:215. The channel-A-to-B normalling is done by substituting the Input object itself rather than a voltage, so a polyphonic cable on Channel A carries across in full, and each of the three normals is broken independently by patching the matching Channel B jack. The panel SVG carries no lettering: every label is drawn in code by PanelLabels at src/Brink/Brink.cpp:540, which prints CHANNEL A, CHANNEL B, CENTER, WIDTH, SIGNAL, POSITION, CTR CV, WID CV, INSIDE, OUTSIDE, LOW, HIGH, AND, OR, XOR and TOGGLE, with an up arrow beside one trigger row and a down arrow beside the other.
